# Sahastitwa Solutions

Sahastitwa Solutions Private Limited is a product company in India. It is developing hardware that improves the efficiency of renewable energy systems.

Alongside that product, it provides custom hardware for indigenous development, design, and manufacturing in India. That custom work can include power electronics, embedded systems, robotics, and industrial automation.

The product’s internal design is not published yet. Custom engagements can stay confidential.

- Home and product: https://sahastitwa.in/
- Custom hardware: https://sahastitwa.in/custom-solutions.html
